title: Change record per production change
description: Machine-generated record linking the work item, commits, author and reviewer identities, approvals, automated check results, artifact digest, deployment time, environment and outcome for every production change.
producer: Praxis work protocol plus source control and deployment pipeline (integration proposed)
signing: Signed by the deployment pipeline identity (proposed)

title: Segregation of duties check per deployment
description: Automated check, recorded per deployment, that the change author did not approve and did not solely trigger the production deployment, with any exception and its approver.

title: Production access grants, sessions and break-glass records
description: Records of every production access grant and session (who, why, scope, approver, start, end, commands or queries executed), break-glass activations with two-person approval, and post-use review.

title: Emergency change records and retrospective approvals
description: Records of emergency changes with declared reason, approver, deployment, and retrospective review completed within the defined window.
format: Change records flagged emergency plus review record

title: Deployment and rollback test records
description: Evidence of each deployment's health verification, of tested rollback for application and schema changes, and of rollback executions with outcome.

title: Infrastructure as code and drift detection results
description: Infrastructure definitions in version control with change records, and periodic drift detection comparing deployed infrastructure and database schema to declarations, including unverifiable objects.
producer: Strata for database schema (exists); infrastructure tool not chosen

title: Customer change notices
description: Per-release notices to each sponsor listing changed control-relevant modules, security-relevant changes and breaking changes, with delivery confirmation.
format: Release notice document plus delivery log
